Choosing the best hard-shell carry-on depends on your budget, how often you fly, and whether you prefer zippers or a latch/aluminum frame. Top-tested options stand out across distinct categories:

#### Top Hard-Shell Carry-On Picks



---

**Best Overall:** Away The Carry-On (~$220–$250)

- *Why it’s a favorite:* Made from durable polycarbonate with an interior compression system and super-smooth 360-degree spinner wheels. It hits the sweet spot of weight, style, and everyday durability backed by a great warranty.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-hard-shell-carry-on-luggage/)



---

**Best Splurge / Luxury Frame:** [Carl Friedrik The Carry-On](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462916611876954,imageDocid:3319366419568364410,gpcid:1074210950215611746,headlineOfferDocid:3110420382900664963,catalogid:16610047321099786223,productDocid:11272932910841760354,rds:PC_1074210950215611746%7CPROD_PC_1074210950215611746&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj_hc_O64OYAxXbTWwGHUadD2cQxa4PeggIAggBCCMQGA) (~$695)

- *Why it’s a favorite:* Features an aluminum frame (no zippers) with Italian Vachetta leather details. It looks like a million bucks, offers water-resistant closure security, and glides effortlessly.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-hard-shell-carry-on-luggage/)



---

**Best Budget Pick:** [Quince Carry-On Suitcase](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462757860087134,imageDocid:10380236225944023017,gpcid:11737610548013105246,headlineOfferDocid:2767297719678975663,catalogid:8705630594903141698,productDocid:12167495777271769968,rds:PC_11737610548013105246%7CPROD_PC_11737610548013105246&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj_hc_O64OYAxXbTWwGHUadD2cQxa4PeggIAggBCCMQKQ) (~$120–$130)

- *Why it’s a favorite:* Built from 100% polycarbonate (comparable to $250+ bags in flex and durability), featuring Japanese Hinomoto spinner wheels at a fraction of the cost.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-hard-shell-carry-on-luggage/)



---

**Best Organization / Closet-Style:** [Solgaard Carry-On Closet](https://www.google.com/search?ibp=oshop&prds=pvt:hg,pvo:29,mid:576462916262833057,imageDocid:4264554538631592318,gpcid:13206973118889126178,headlineOfferDocid:10994244369248836380,catalogid:8654436646831235264,productDocid:10221138077477386242,rds:PC_16388674786382679327%7CPROD_PC_16388674786382679327&q=product&sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwj_hc_O64OYAxXbTWwGHUadD2cQxa4PeggIAggBCCMQOg) (~$285)

- *Why it’s a favorite:* Includes a built-in, collapsible shelving system inside the shell—unpacking at a hotel literally takes five seconds.



---

**Best for Build Quality & Tech/Features:** Aer Carry-On (~$299–$319)

- *Why it’s a favorite:* Heavy-duty build with a convenient built-in wheel-locking mechanism so your bag doesn’t roll away on sloped train floors or airport shuttles.[[1]](https://www.nytimes.com/wirecutter/reviews/best-hard-shell-carry-on-luggage/)
